info.title: Majorsilence Reporting MCP Server
info.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants work with RDL/RDLC reports — render them to PDF/HTML/XLSX/CSV/image, inspect their structure, lint them for engine compatibility, and scaffold new ones — through Majorsilence Reporting's engine.
